articles.title: How sensitive data from Centrelink and other Australian agencies may have been fed to Palantir software
articles.summary: Exclusive: Personal information of Centrelink clients and childcare workers is among data shared with ACIC, which uses US tech company’s software. The personal information of Centrelink customers, taxpayers and childcare workers is among a trove of sensitive data that may be ending up in Palantir’s…
body: As Guardian Australia reported in September, Palantir’s software is used by the Australian Criminal Intelligence Commission (ACIC) as part of the multi-agency fraud fusion taskforce, which was established in 2022 with the goal of targeting fraud in government payments from the national disability insurance scheme, childcare and welfare.

New documents, released under freedom of information requests, reveal the extent to which at least 10 government agencies share sensitive data with the taskforce, which could be fed into Palantir’s software.

The controversial US tech company, co-founded by the Donald Trump-aligned billionaire Peter Thiel, has clients including the Israeli military and US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) that use the software to analyse vast amounts of data.

While the company has insisted it has no access to the data clients enter into the software, the Greens leader, David Shoebridge, has led calls for a ban on Palantir contracts with the Australian government.

articles.title: Coffee lovers and matcha girlies, rejoice! There’s an abundance of Advent calendars just for you
articles.summary: From K-cup fanatics to herbal tea enthusiasts, here are the top gifting options to wet every whistle. Link to other advents. Sign up for the Filter US newsletter, your weekly guide to buying fewer, better things.
body: The holiday season can be exhausting: shopping, hosting, plotting out an elaborate popcorn garland for your annual holiday party, etc. This means that caffeine is really ready for its moment to shine. Enter the caffeinated Advent calendar. This year, there’s a bevy of Advent calendar options for coffee and tea aficionados alike, from the K-cup devotees to the single-origin matcha obsessives. I’ve tried a bunch of them – and have the energy levels to prove it. Here are the best of the year.

If you’re looking to give someone 24 cups of very cozy tea this winter, Stash has you covered. Their sturdy, open-book-shaped Advent calendar reveals a mix of flavored black, green and herbal teas. Wake up with a cup of Christmas Shortbread black tea, sip some (green) Tropical Snowflake during your afternoon slump and turn down with some Blueberry Joy before bed, depending on the day. I loved that these felt boldly flavored without too much artificial edge.

articles.title: Kindness of strangers: I was stranded, dressed as a flapper, on a freezing night. Then a cheerful taxi driver pulled over
articles.summary: My tyre was blown so he changed it for me. When I offered payment he said, ‘Don’t be ridiculous, love’ I had to fight not to lose control of the car. I was in my early 20s and driving home from a fancy dress party when bang – my tyre suddenly blew.
body: It was 1982 in Canberra; a foggy, bitterly cold night in the middle of winter. I was wearing a silly flapper dress and high heels – I’m not sure I’d even packed a jacket! I had a spare tyre in the back but little idea how to change it. My options were to make the one-hour walk home alone or wait to see if another car passed and could offer me a ride. For 30 minutes I sat in the driver’s seat helplessly, unsure what to do.

The roads in Canberra were always empty at that hour. There was nothing in the way of public transport and taxis were rarer than hen’s teeth – New York City this was not! So it felt heaven sent when I eventually saw a taxi approach, light on to signal it was available.
I flagged the taxi down and asked for a ride home, explaining that I’d call a tow truck and come back for my car in the morning. He had another idea – and offered to change my tyre for me.

So in the middle of a freezing winter’s night, this cheerful, older taxi driver hopped out to change my tyre. He waited to see me drive off safely before leaving and refused my offer of payment for helping. I believe his words were: “Don’t be ridiculous, love!”

articles.title: Inside Baby2Baby’s Star-Studded, Record-Breaking 15th Anniversary Gala
articles.summary: Demi Moore was honored with the Giving Tree Award at the 2026 Baby2Baby Gala for using her voice and platform to advocate for vulnerable children. The evening celebrated Baby2Baby’s 15th anniversary and raised a record-breaking $20+ million to support the national non-profit organization.
body: On Saturday evening at West Hollywood’s Pacific Design Center, Demi Moore asked a ballroom filled with Hollywood stars to take two deep breaths. The actress, who was being honored at Baby2Baby’s 15th anniversary gala, wanted everyone to consider the sense of relief that comes when a parent no longer has to worry about providing basic necessities for their child. It was one of the evening’s most moving moments, and a reminder of the mission behind a night that would go on to raise over $20 million dollars—the highest fundraising total for the nonprofit to date.

Presented by Paul Mitchell, the annual benefit drew a guest list that included Katy Perry and Justin Trudeau, Jessica Alba, Kerry Washington, Ciara, Chrissy Teigen, Paris Hilton, Sofía Vergara, Elsa Hosk, and Miranda Kerr, all gathering once more to celebrate the beloved organization.

articles.title: Zendaya Revives a 2000s Golden Gown at the 2026 Governors Awards
articles.summary: Hint: The shimmering golden dress is from the fall 2007 season.
body: Zendaya is no stranger to shutting down a red carpet—so did you really not expect her to deliver a major fashion serve at the 2026 Governors Awards tonight?

The annual ceremony serves as the official kickoff to the 2027 awards season, so it’s no big surprise that the superstar and her stylist, Law Roach, started things off with a bang this evening—by cultivating a headline-worthy fashion moment worthy of the red carpet. The actor went for gold at the ceremony, choosing a shimmering metallic gown with three-dimensional padding at the hips. And better yet, the striking frock is vintage, too—from the late 2000s. Can you guess the brand and season?

Zendaya and Roach unearthed the fringed column gown from Giles Deacon’s fall 2007 collection, and it feels just as fresh and contemporary today (despite being almost a decade old). Of course. Zendaya and Roach are long known for turning throwback designs into modern-day hits: It’s one of their best fashion tricks. In the past, she has embraced everything from priceless archival Galliano to ’90s Versace to flashy Bob Mackie creations—and she has a knack for always making them feel just as relevant for today.

articles.title: A Deep Dive Into Hailey Bieber’s Many, Many Face Masks
articles.summary: From cult K-beauty treatments to depuffing creams, collagen wraps, and LED light therapy, Rhode founder Hailey Bieber takes her masking seriously.
body: “Dealing with my issues one mask a time,” wrote Hailey Bieber beneath a recent Instagram carousel. While she’s not elaborating on said issues, her extensive collection of face masks have been exposed for every skincare obsessive’s over-analysis. Hailey Bieber has a face mask for every occasion and skin concern, it seems.

There she is, covered in mustard-yellow paste, slathered in a thick white cream, encased in a glossy lavender-grey treatment, and illuminated by the electric-blue glow of an LED device. There are hydrogel sheets, eye patches, and a rather arresting cobalt-blue mask from a recent trip to Seoul. Bieber is clearly not afraid to cast the net wide in pursuit of good skin.

As she’s previously explained, her approach when her skin is irritated is minimal: rinsing with water, using prescribed azelaic acid and clindamycin, hypochlorous acid, and Rhode’s ceramide-rich Glazing Milk. In her 2025 Beauty Secrets video, she also revealed that she generally skips a full morning cleanse in favor of a water rinse, saving the heavier-duty moisturizing for nighttime.
points: From cult K-beauty treatments to depuffing creams, collagen wraps, and LED light therapy, Rhode founder Hailey Bieber takes her masking seriously.
